description: Create Go types for Group, ScalingConfig, Resources, and the ValidateGroup function in engine/internal/config/group.go. This is the shared validation logic used by both Admin API and CMS transform for parity (grill finding: validation parity).
steps: Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-grouped-workers-phase1/engine/internal/config/group.go with: ScalingMode constants (static, dynamic, ephemeral), Resources struct (CPURequest, CPULimit, MemoryRequest, MemoryLimit), ScalingConfig struct (Mode, MinReplicas, MaxReplicas, ScaleDownDelay, StartupTimeout, Resources), Group struct (ID, Name, Description, Version, Connections, Scaling, Enabled, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt).

Implement ValidateGroup(g *Group) error with: ID required and regex ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$, Name required, MinReplicas >= 0, MaxReplicas >= MinReplicas, static mode requires MinReplicas > 0, Scaling.Mode must be one of static|dynamic|ephemeral (grill finding #8).
Add GroupAuditData struct that holds Group pointer plus Connections slice for denormalized audit storage (design specifies audit stores full state including connections for rollback).
Add GroupSummary struct for list response (ID, Name, Enabled, Version, UpdatedAt).
acceptance_criteria: go build ./... passes from engine/ directory
Group struct has all fields from design: ID, Name, Description, Version, Connections []string, Scaling ScalingConfig, Enabled bool, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt
ValidateGroup rejects invalid IDs (uppercase, special chars, empty), rejects static mode with minReplicas=0, rejects invalid ScalingMode values
ScalingMode constants exist for static, dynamic, ephemeral
findings: ValidateGroup uses newErr(Validation, ...) from errors.go for classified errors. Resources struct fields are optional (omitempty) to allow partial resource specs. ScalingConfig.Resources is a pointer so it can be nil when no resource overrides are needed. GroupAuditData includes a redundant Connections field alongside Group.Connections for audit log completeness per design requirement.
